plugins.name: Easing+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: A normalized cubic Bezier editor with a focused set of reusable presets.

plugins.name: Player+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Adds a drawing pause button and preview quality controls to the playback bar.

plugins.name: Native FX
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Adds native multi-pass effects using AfterClip-compatible effect types.
plugins.warning: Native FX effects are not compatible with vanilla Panzoid Clipmaker 3. Projects using this pack require Zoidium or AfterClip.

plugins.name: Light+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Upgrades the standard Light button with a chooser for Spot, Point, Directional, and Hemisphere lights.

plugins.name: AfterClip
plugins.author: AfterClip
plugins.description: Adds AfterClip custom shaders and group presets, normalized for Zoidium.
plugins.warning: AfterClip effects use Zoidium's premultiplied source-over convention and are not vanilla Panzoid-compatible.

plugins.name: Afterzoid Shader Pack 4
plugins.author: AlipFX
plugins.description: A complete collection of native Panzoid shader effects.
